section_critical_finding.title: PyTorch's CUDAGraph does NOT call cuGraphAddKernelNode explicitly
section_critical_finding.evidence: cipher_rt_graph_add_kernel_calls = 0 after both capture phase and replay phase; counter was incrementally exercised at 5 levels (driver cuGraphAddKernelNode + _v2 + ExecKernelNodeSetParams + _v2 + cudart cudaGraphAddKernelNode) and none fired during vLLM workload.
section_critical_finding.root_cause: PyTorch's CUDAGraph capture uses cuStreamBeginCapture(stream) → run kernels normally (each cuLaunchKernel during capture is recorded as a kernel node by the driver's internal capture mechanism) → cuStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph) → cuGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph). The explicit AddKernelNode API is only called by direct-CUDA-graph-API callers (raw CUDA, some HPC frameworks, some JAX configurations).
section_critical_finding.implication: Capture-time substitution for PyTorch graphs requires a different mechanism: either (a) hook cuLaunchKernel + detect stream-is-capturing state via cuStreamGetCaptureInfo + substitute func before passing to real cuLaunchKernel during capture; or (b) hook cuStreamEndCapture + walk the resulting CUgraph via cuGraphGetNodes + rewrite via cuGraphKernelNodeSetParams (graph template, not exec); or (c) hook cuGraphInstantiate + walk + rewrite via cuGraphExecKernelNodeSetParams post-instantiate (which my shim DOES provide but PyTorch path doesn't trigger if substitution decision wasn't made at instantiate time).
section_critical_finding.what_this_substep_delivers: Substitution infrastructure for direct-API callers (HPC, raw CUDA, JAX direct). cuGraphAddKernelNode + cuGraphExecKernelNodeSetParams + cudaGraphAddKernelNode shims correct + ABI-additive + counter-instrumented + Mode-1 correctness verified. Foundation laid for future Marlin/Koopman actuator wiring via cipher_rt_graph_substitute_decide weak ref.
section_critical_finding.what_this_substep_does_NOT_deliver_yet: PyTorch-specific capture-time substitution. Closing that gap requires .8.5b sub-substep with one of (a)/(b)/(c) above. The most idiomatic path is (a) — cuLaunchKernel hook detects stream capture via cuStreamGetCaptureInfo_v2 and substitutes during capture. This composes with B.6''.9.8.1's existing cuLaunchKernel hook and is a smaller incremental change than (b)/(c).
section_critical_finding.memory_11_no_scope_degrade_honored: Substep delivers what was buildable additively + surfaces the PyTorch-specific gap honestly. NOT masking the zero counter. NOT silently dropping scope. Recording for .8.5b adjudication.
